descriptions.w3d_d20a_direction_speed_800106e0: Returns 0 unless 0x8000f804 reports the object ready; otherwise reads the speed (+188) of the tuning record from 0x80341694(self, 0), using 0.05 times +184 when it is zero, normalizes the direction at +36 in place, scales it by the speed and returns 0x8000feb8(self, time + 20.0f).
